title: Find Your Why
habit: Drink a glass of water when you wake up
tip: Why whole food? Real food fuels movement, energy, and mood.
action: Write your why in one sentence and save it in the app.

title: Know Your Starting Line
habit: Complete your daily check-in
tip: Tracking without obsessing: notice energy, sleep, and digestion.
action: Log your baseline: energy, sleep, mood, and how your clothes fit (optional).

title: Pantry Reset
habit: Read one label before you eat it
tip: The 5-ingredient label test: if you cannot picture each ingredient, put it back.
action: Pantry clean-out: move, donate, or finish ultra-processed items.

title: Stock the Basics
habit: Keep fruit and cut veggies where you can see them
tip: Build a whole-food pantry on any budget.
action: Make your first grocery list from the template and shop.

title: Water First
habit: Drink 8 cups of water (or your goal)
tip: Hydration affects hunger and energy more than most people realize.
action: Set up a water bottle routine or reminders.

title: Rethink Your Drinks
habit: Swap one sweetened drink for water, tea, or coffee
tip: Liquid sugar is one of the easiest wins on this plan.
action: Find 2 drinks you enjoy with no added sugar.

title: Week 1 Check-In
habit: Reflect for 5 minutes
tip: Small wins add up. Progress beats perfection.
action: Review your week and pick one thing to keep doing.

title: The Plate Method
habit: Build one plate with the guide
tip: Half veggies, a quarter protein, a quarter smart carbs, plus a little fat.
action: Notice one balanced plate today.

title: Protein at Breakfast
habit: Include protein in your first meal
tip: Protein keeps you full and supports your training.
action: Pick 2 protein breakfasts for the week.

title: Color Your Plate
habit: Eat 3 different colors of produce
tip: Variety, fiber, and gut health basics.
action: Add one new fruit or veggie to your grocery list.

title: Smart Carbs
habit: Choose a whole grain or starchy veggie over a refined one
tip: Carbs are not the enemy; pick quality.
action: Swap one refined-carb staple for a whole version.

title: Healthy Fats
habit: Add one healthy fat to a meal
tip: Fats that help you feel satisfied.
action: Make a simple olive oil and lemon dressing.

title: Eat Slowly
habit: Put your fork down between bites at one meal
tip: Hunger and fullness cues matter.
action: Eat one meal with no screens.

title: Week 2 Check-In
habit: Reflect for 5 minutes
tip: What is your body telling you?
action: Compare this week's check-ins to Week 1.

title: Plan Your Week
habit: Plan tomorrow's meals tonight
tip: A 10-minute weekly meal plan saves decision fatigue.
action: Fill in meals for the next 3 days.

title: Batch-Cook Day
habit: Cook once, eat twice
tip: Batch proteins, grains, and roasted veggies.
action: Batch-cook 1 protein, 1 grain, and 1 tray of veggies.

title: 15-Minute Meals
habit: Make one meal in 15 minutes or less
tip: Fast meals from your prepped basics.
action: Try one quick whole-food meal idea.

title: Snack Smart
habit: Pair protein and produce at snack time
tip: Snacks that hold you over until the next meal.
action: Prep 3 grab-and-go snacks.

title: Flavor Without the Box
habit: Season one meal with herbs and spices
tip: Spices and marinades without additives.
action: Mix one homemade seasoning blend.

title: Leftovers, Remixed
habit: Turn last night's dinner into today's lunch
tip: Reduce waste and save time.
action: Remix one leftover into a bowl, wrap, or salad.

title: Week 3 Check-In
habit: Reflect for 5 minutes
tip: Your kitchen confidence is growing.
action: Pick your 3 go-to meals.

title: Eating Out
habit: Choose the plate method when you order
tip: Read a menu the whole-food way.
action: Look up a favorite restaurant menu and pick your order ahead.

title: On the Go
habit: Pack one meal or snack before you leave
tip: Travel, work days, and road trips.
action: Build a go-bag snack kit.

title: Cravings
habit: Pause 10 minutes before acting on a craving
tip: Why cravings happen and what to do.
action: Write your top 2 craving triggers and a plan for each.

title: Social Plates
habit: Enjoy a social meal without guilt
tip: Family, parties, and saying no thanks kindly.
action: Plan for your next social event.

title: Budget Whole Food
habit: Shop with a budget in mind
tip: Frozen, canned, bulk, and seasonal whole food for less.
action: Plan a week around 5 low-cost staples.

title: Sleep and Stress
habit: Turn off screens 30 minutes before bed
tip: Sleep and stress affect hunger and food choices.
action: Set a simple wind-down routine.

title: Week 4 Check-In
habit: Reflect for 5 minutes
tip: Bouncing back after an off day.
action: Write your next-meal reset plan for rough days.

title: Look How Far You've Come
habit: Complete your full check-in
tip: Reviewing your 30 days.
action: Compare Day 2 with today: energy, sleep, mood, habits.

title: Your Day 31 Plan
habit: Celebrate, then keep one habit going
tip: Your 80/20 for life.
action: Pick your 3 keeper habits for Day 31 and beyond.
